job:
Senior Product Designer

We're building innovative digital products that delight millions of users worldwide. Our design team is expanding, and we're looking for an experienced Senior Product Designer to lead strategic design initiatives across our platform.

MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- 5+ years of professional product design experience with proven track record shipping consumer or enterprise products
- Expert-level proficiency in Figma; experience building and maintaining design systems at scale
- Demonstrated expertise in user research methodologies (interviews, usability testing, analytics interpretation)
- End-to-end product ownership: from discovery through launch and iteration
- Portfolio showcasing 3+ shipped products with measurable impact
- Strong collaboration skills working with engineering, product management, and leadership teams

NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience designing B2B SaaS or mobile applications
- Knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive design practices
- Background in interaction design and motion design
- Experience mentoring junior designers
- Familiarity with design operations and team processes

Responsibilities include leading design strategy, conducting user research, prototyping and testing solutions, and working cross-functionally to deliver polished, user-centered products.
